sources.description: The Jets didn’t quite get Geno Smith for free this offseason, but it was darned close. Gang Green reacquired its once-second round Draft pick in a trade that involved swapping a sixth round pick for a seventh round pick and tacking a $3 million sweetener onto Smith’s contract.
